evidence.query: Android 14 foreground service mediaPlayback requirements; App Store audio background

results.title: Foreground service types are required (Android Developers)
Radio App Rejected with Guideline 5.2.3 using Radio-Browser.info

evidence.summary: Android 14+ needs foreground service type mediaPlayback plus FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permission (player libs usually declare). Apple: a radio app built on radio-browser.info was rejected under 5.2.3 (Legal): Apple asked to limit to open stations or show documentary evidence of rights to third-party streams. Apple search for background audio mode returned nothing; UIBackgroundModes audio is standard but unverified here.

evidence.query: iOS ATS http radio streams NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsForMedia Android cleartext
evidence.summary: Many radio streams are plain http. iOS: NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsForMedia covers AVFoundation loads only; keys needing justification can trigger review. Android 9+: cleartext blocked by default, need networkSecurityConfig. Not confirmed from official Apple/Android docs.

evidence.query: internet radio app GDPR privacy policy radio-browser.info copyright
evidence.summary: Radio Browser gets user IP and search terms; stream hosts see IP. Apps typically publish a privacy policy naming each recipient; directory data is public domain, software GPL (the API server, not the client libs). Not authoritative GDPR guidance; retransmission legality needs a lawyer. No accounts and local-only favorites keep GDPR scope small.

evidence.query: COPPA CCPA music streaming app without accounts local-only favorites
evidence.summary: COPPA applies to child-directed apps or collection of persistent identifiers; a general-audience local-only radio app with no ad SDKs likely out of scope but sources do not address it directly. Privacy policy link needed in app; audit third-party SDKs for identifiers. Apple nutrition label / Play Data safety handling not confirmed.

evidence.query: radio-browser.info API usage rules free commercial
evidence.summary: Radio Browser API is free and open source, usable in free and non-free software; no rate limit documented. Needs descriptive User-Agent. All libs chosen are free (MIT/Apache-2.0). Only costs: Apple dev $99/yr, Google Play one-time fee (figures not researched here).

No backend of our own. Community-run directory has multiple servers via DNS lookup of all.api.radio-browser.info; clients should randomize and fail over, send click reports. No SLA found. Dependency risk: community service; stream URLs rot, need error handling.

RNTP 4.1.2: no Snyk vulns. mmkv CVE-2024-21668 (encryption key logged on Android) fixed in 2.11.0 so v4.x fine; we do not use encryption. Untrusted input: station names/URLs/ICY titles from the internet -> render as plain text, validate URLs, no auth/secrets in app.

evidence.query: react-native-track-player HLS live stream ICY metadata background playback lock screen
evidence.summary: V5 (@rntp/player) is commercially licensed; v4 stays Apache-2.0. Live HLS needs isLive on Android. ICY on Android had bugs in v4 era (#2638, #2149) fixed in v5.x. react-native-anything-player has ICY but is PolyForm Noncommercial and not on npm.

evidence.query: react-native-track-player v4 ICY metadata PlaybackMetadataReceived StreamTitle

results.title: RNTP PR 384 Icecast and Shoutcast metadata

evidence.summary: v4 has ICY via Audio*MetadataReceived events (old PlaybackMetadataReceived deprecated); reports of firing only on startup on some Android radio streams, fixed in v5.1.x which is commercial. Legacy-charset StreamTitle garbling is a known ICY issue (radio-garden lib adds icyCharset).

evidence.query: radio-browser.info API usage rules user agent server list
evidence.summary: Radio Browser API is free; needs descriptive User-Agent; DNS discovery of all.api.radio-browser.info; npm radio-browser-api 6.0.3 MIT, fetch-based browser+node; RN untested.

decision.rationale: Latest npm 4.1.2 is Apache-2.0 (verified npm view); background playback, lock-screen/notification controls, HLS. Pin to 4.x since v5 (@rntp/player) is commercial. Risk: v4 last release 2025-08, Android live-stream issues.
